description.description: Optional human-readable label for the row, surfaced in UIs and preview prompts.

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the row's validity period begins, or null when unknown.

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the row's validity period ends, or null when the row is still current / unknown.

related_to.description: Umbrella edge for the 14 POLE+O domain relations (+ Tree extensions). Discriminated by ``semantic_type``.

alias_of.description: Surface form is an alias for the target. Distinct from structural ``same_as`` (which is the dedup-confirmed merge edge) — ``alias_of`` is LLM-extractable narrative.

employed_by.description: Person is employed by an organization. Carries role + date range; the canonical Tree subtype for the resulting period is event/employment.

end_date.description: End of the relationship in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or None when the relationship is ongoing or the end is unknown.
end_date.title: End Date

role.description: Role or title held during the relationship (e.g. 'senior engineer', 'board member').
role.title: Role

start_date.description: Start of the relationship in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or None when the start is unknown / open-ended.
start_date.title: Start Date

experienced_by.description: Tree extension: a person experienced an event (commonly an event with subtype ``episode``). Re-routes the legacy ``EdgeType.EXPERIENCED`` semantics.

role.description: Role the person played in the event (e.g. 'protagonist', 'witness'). None when unspecified.
role.title: Role

has_task.description: Tree extension: a person has a task (object with subtype ``task``). Re-routes the legacy ``EdgeType.TODO`` semantics into the POLE+O umbrella so the LLM emits a single ``related_to`` edge type.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the task — e.g. 'pending', 'in_progress', 'done', 'cancelled'. None means unspecified.
status.title: Status

headquarters_at.description: An organization's headquarters is at a location.

involved.description: An object was involved in an event (e.g. weapon, evidence).

role.description: Role the object played in the event (e.g. 'weapon', 'evidence', 'collateral').
role.title: Role

knows.description: Two persons know each other (acquaintance-grade link).

located_at.description: An object or event is located at a place (with optional date range so the relation can describe historical placement).

from_date.description: Start of the period the relation held, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: End of the period the relation held, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or None when the relation is current / unknown.
to_date.title: To Date

member_of.description: Person is a member of an organization (board, club, team). Carries role + date range.

end_date.description: End of the relationship in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or None when the relationship is ongoing or the end is unknown.
end_date.title: End Date

role.description: Role or title held during the relationship (e.g. 'senior engineer', 'board member').
role.title: Role

start_date.description: Start of the relationship in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or None when the start is unknown / open-ended.
start_date.title: Start Date

occurred_at.description: An event occurred at a location (point-in-time anchor).

owns.description: A person or organization owns an object.

acquisition_date.description: Date of ownership acquisition in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or None when the date is unknown.
acquisition_date.title: Acquisition Date

participated_in.description: A person or organization participated in an event.

role.description: Role the participant played in the event (e.g. 'speaker', 'attendee', 'organizer').
role.title: Role

partner_with.description: Two organizations are in a partnership relation.

resides_at.description: A person resides at a location, with optional date range.

from_date.description: Start of the period the relation held, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: End of the period the relation held, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or None when the relation is current / unknown.
to_date.title: To Date

subsidiary_of.description: An organization is a subsidiary of another organization.

uses.description: A person or organization uses an object (no transfer of ownership).

event.description: An event (incident, meeting, transaction, communication, etc.).

aliases.description: Alternative names or labels for the event
aliases.title: Aliases

outcome.description: Short summary of what happened or resulted from the event
outcome.title: Outcome

time.description: Time the event occurred (HH:MM:SS, UTC unless otherwise stated)
time.title: Time

fact.description:
A free-form proposition that doesn't fit any typed entity relation.

Facts (#031) are the LLM extraction escape-hatch for propositions
whose subject or object doesn't resolve to a POLE+O entity worth
traversing, OR whose relation doesn't match any registered
``related_to`` semantic. They are **island nodes** — the envelope
validator rejects every edge with a ``fact`` endpoint, so a fact
has zero edges to or from it. Retrieval is by ``name`` /
``subject`` / ``object`` string match or vector similarity only
(see :class:`tree.memory.query.kgquery.KGQuery`).

Bi-temporal columns ``valid_from`` / ``valid_until`` live on
:class:`tree.entities.knowledge_graph.KnowledgeGraphEntry` and are
populated at extraction time when the LLM emits them. Supersession
of contradictory facts lands in #032; until then contradictory
facts coexist and both surface in retrieval.

The ``object`` field shadows the builtin :class:`object` type, so
it's stored on the Python class as ``object_`` with a Pydantic
``alias="object"`` — the wire / JSON-schema / LLM-prompt key stays
the plain string ``"object"``. ``populate_by_name=True`` lets
construction work from either spelling.

object.description: The proposition's right side. Free-text OR a resolved entity name.
object.title: Object

predicate.description: The relation verb (e.g. 'prefers', 'lives_in', 'speaks'). If this fits one of the registered ``related_to`` semantics AND both endpoints resolve as entities, emit a ``related_to`` edge with that ``semantic_type`` instead.
predicate.title: Predicate

subject.description: The proposition's left side. Free-text OR a resolved entity name (no inverse lookup — facts are island nodes).
subject.title: Subject

address.description: Street address or postal form when applicable
address.title: Address

aliases.description: Alternative names, abbreviations, or translations of the location
aliases.title: Aliases

coordinates.description: Decimal latitude/longitude pair, e.g. '37.7749,-122.4194'. Single string keeps the JSON-schema scalar-friendly for the LLM.
coordinates.title: Coordinates

country.description: Country the location belongs to (use ISO 3166 short name when known)
country.title: Country

object.description: A physical or digital object (vehicle, phone, document, device, etc.).

aliases.description: Alternative names or labels for the object
aliases.title: Aliases

identifier.description: External identifier (license plate, IMEI, URL, etc.)
identifier.title: Identifier

make.description: Manufacturer or brand of the object
make.title: Make

model.description: Model name or version of the object
model.title: Model

serial_number.description: Serial number or other unique-per-instance identifier
serial_number.title: Serial Number

organization.description: An organization (company, nonprofit, government body, etc.).

aliases.description: Alternative names, acronyms, or trade names for the organization
aliases.title: Aliases

jurisdiction.description: Legal jurisdiction the organization is registered or operates in (e.g. 'Delaware, US', 'United Kingdom')
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

registration_number.description: Government or registry identifier (EIN, company number, etc.)
registration_number.title: Registration Number

person.description: An individual person mentioned in or related to the content.

aliases.description: Alternative names, nicknames, or references to this person
aliases.title: Aliases

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)
date_of_birth.title: Date Of Birth

preference.description: A preference, opinion, or pattern exhibited by a person.
